# `oaap notify`

recipient lists and notifications (RFC-0080).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap notify {show,list-set,list-remove,route,test,log,settings,run} [name] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | the list (list-set, list-remove, test) or the category/type (route) |
| `--tenant TENANT` | a tenant's label (default: the node) |
| `--to TO` | addresses or rolle:server_admin / rolle:tenant_admin, comma separated |
| `--cc CC` | -- |
| `--bcc BCC` | -- |
| `--prefix PREFIX` | for list-set: a subject prefix |
| `--lists LISTS` | for route: list names, comma separated; empty = the mandatory list |
| `--subject SUBJECT` | for route: subject template ({knoten} {mandant} {instanz} {typ} {kurz}) |
| `--disk-warn DISK_WARN` | -- |
| `--disk-crit DISK_CRIT` | -- |
| `--all` | for log: every tenant |
| `--limit LIMIT` | (default `30`) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `show` | yes |
| `list-set` | yes |
| `list-remove` | yes |
| `route` | yes |
| `test` | yes |
| `log` | yes |
| `settings` | yes |
| `run` | yes |
